purpose: Give one contributing reason among several.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
Plain clause + こともあって; N / な-adjective + なこともあって
Partly because it was a holiday, the roads were busy.
I chose this apartment partly because it is near the station.
I was nervous partly because it was my first presentation.
formation: Plain clause + こともあって; N / な-adjective + なこともあって
restrictions: The reason helps explain a result but is not necessarily sufficient alone.
mistake: も implies additional causes or circumstances.
